RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the December 6, 2006/Agrahayana 15, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
Agreements with foreign countries for
export of iron ore
*201. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that agreements
have been signed with foreign countries,
including China, for export of iron ore from
India;
(b) if so, the details of those agreements,
agreement-wise and country-wise;
(c) the details of quantity of iron ore
being exported from the country, per
annum;
(d) whether the exports would hamper
the indigenous steel industry in the long
run; and
(e) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto?
Rural Development Schemes in
Andhra Pradesh
*202. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Ministry of
Rural Development is implementing
schemes like Swarnjayanti Gram Swarozgar
Yojana (SGSY), Sampoorna Grameen
Rojgar Yojana (SGRY), National Food for
Work Programme (NFFWP), Indira Awaas
Yojana (IAY), Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak
Yojana (PMGSY), Drought Prone Area
Programme (DPAP), Desert Development
Programme (DDP), Integrated Wasteland
Development Programme (IWDP),
Accelerated Rural Water Supply
Programme (ARWSP), Total Sanitation
Campaign (TSC) and National Rural
Employment Guarantee Act (NREGA)
through Andhra Pradesh Government;
(b) if so, the funds allocated and released
by the Central Government and the State
Government, Scheme-wise during the years
2003-04, 2004-05 and 2005-06;
(c) the details of utilization of funds,
Scheme-wise, by Andhra Pradesh, with
justification for low utilization, if any; and
(d) the action taken by Government to
utilize the maximum amount of funds
available in Andhra Pradesh?
Development of handloom sector in
Kerala
*203. SHRI THENNALA G.
BALAKRISHNA PILLAI: Will the
Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal for the development of handloom
sector in Kannoor, Kerala; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?

64
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Honesty and transparency in Defence
deals
†*204. SHRI BASHISTHA NARAIN
SINGH: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the policy of
Government to ensure honesty and
transparency in Defence deals;
(b) the efforts being made by
Government to ensure timely spending of
money allocated in Defence budgets;
(c) whether it is a fact that a large chunk
of the allocated amount remains unspent;
and
(d) the details of the plan of Government
to encourage indigenous industry to carry
out exports in the field of Defence
equipments?
Fratricide among armed forces
*205. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) in which areas majority of cases of
fratricide among armed forces had taken
place during the recent years;
(b) whether Government have gone into
the causes of such cases;
(c) the steps taken to improve service
conditions of the armed personnel, posted
in disturbed areas;
(d) whether it is a fact that lack of social
security to the families of soldiers has led
them to take such extreme step; and
(e) if so, what steps are being taken by
Government to improve the welfare
measures for their families?
Fund under PMGSY to Jharkhand
†*206. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the amount that has been allocated
to the State of Jharkhand under the Pradhan
Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana;
(b) the amount utilized out of the said
amount; and
(c) the current status of the said scheme
in Jharkhand?
Desert and barren land in the country
*207. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of desert and barren land
area in the country  as on 30th June, 2006
other than Rajasthan, State-wise;
(b) the increase/decrease in the desert
and barren land area during the last three
years, State-wise;
(c) what are the main reasons for
increase in the desert and barren land areas
and the steps being taken to reduce such
land;
(d) how far the agricultural production
has increased or decreased during the same
period, State-wise and year-wise; and
(e) whether some guidance has been
obtained from Central Asian countries for
development of the rural land; if so, the
details thereof?
Military Academy at Barrackpore
*208. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to refer to answer to Unstarred Question
1310 given in the Rajya Sabha on the 15th
December, 2004 and state:

65
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(a) whether the proposal for
establishment of Military Academy at
Barrackpore has been finalised; and
(b) if so, by when this Academy is likely
to start functioning?
Minimum pension under P.F. linked
pension scheme
†*209. SHRI ALI ANWAR: Will the
Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the amount of minimum pension
fixed under the P.F. linked pension scheme;
(b) whether this amount is lesser than
the minimum wages fixed for the daily
wagers;
(c) if so, whether Government are
contemplating to increase the same; and
(d) if so, by when and if not, the reasons
therefor?
Arms seizure by Army in Kolkata
*210. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Army and the State
Police recovered a huge stockpile of arms
and ammunition, including over 500 anti-
personnel landmines, 543 anti-personnel
mines, 691 bullets of 9 mm caliber, 340
bullets of 7.62 mm caliber, 58 bullets of
.303 caliber and 5.56 mm INSAS
ammunition, manufactured at the Ichapur
ordnance factory at Behala in Kolkata;
(b) whether the seizure is one of the
largest recoveries of mines and other
weapons from any metropolitan city
during the recent times;
(c) if so, whether any inquiry was
conducted; and
(d) the steps taken to check such
disappearance of arms from the ordnance
factory?
Check on cyber crimes
*211. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE
THAKUR : Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken any
steps to check cyber crimes in India,
particularly in view of the increased spread
of information technology; and
(b) if so, what are the details thereof?
Defence system to counter enemy
attack
†*212. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether we have a strong defence
system to counter an enemy country attack,
despite our being a nuclear State;
(b) whether common people of the
country have been given any training to
combat it; and
(c) the strategic areas and establish-
ments in India which face higher threat
perception of nuclear attack?
Employment security
†*213. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the job
security of the employees is under threat
due to flexible attitude being adopted by

66
the Government, with regard to labour
matters;
(b) whether it is a fact that an anarchical
situation can develop as a result of tussle
between labour and capitalism due to non
implementation of labour laws in Special
Economic Zones (SEZs);
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) whether Government would
consider to fulfil the basic needs of the
workers to be employed in such Special
Economic Zones?
Crime against women
*214. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA : Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) what efforts the Ministry is making,
in coordination with the States and local
bodies, to reduce offences against women
looking at the latest National Crime Records
Bureau Report;
(b) whether it is a fact that many crimes
are not reported due to various factors and
the social status of women in the society;
(c) whether any statistics with regard
to crime have been prepared particularly
against dalit and lower strata of women
during the last two years; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
ILO Report on economic growth in
Asia
*215. SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE: Will the Minister of
LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether according to a recent report
of International Labour Organisation,
economic growth in Asia has meant longer
working hours, lower pay and fewer jobs
in this region; and
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto?
Legislative Assembly for Andaman
and Nicobar Islands
†*216. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the representatives of
Andaman and Nicobar Islands have
demanded for creation of Legislative
Assembly, on the lines of Pondicherry;
(b) whether it is a fact that many
Parliamentary Committees have also
recommended constitution of Legislative
Assembly in Andaman and Nicobar;
(c) if so, whether Government have
taken any decision for constitution of
Legislative Assembly in Andaman and
Nicobar; and
(d) if so, by when the Legislative
Assembly would be constituted there?
Employment opportunity in rural areas
*217. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to refer to answer to Unstarred
Question 861 given in the Rajya Sabha on
29th November, 2006 and state:
(a) whether the plan to generate five
lakh jobs for rural BPL families during the
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

67
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Eleventh Five Year Plan Period envisages a
special demand-based skill development
programme from members of the BPL
families in rural areas; and
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the role/responsibility contemplated for
the textile industry in deciding the training
programme and sharing costs?
Beneficiaries under SGSY in
Orissa
†*218. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of people benefited by
Swarnjayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana
(SGSY) in various parts of the country,
especially in Orissa;
(b) whether Government would release
more funds under this Scheme in view of
unemployment and starvation in Orissa;
and
(c) if so, how many more people are
likely to be provided employment under
the said Scheme?
List of ULFA people to Bangladesh
†*219. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India had
handed over a list of 113 terrorists to
Bangladesh, which included the key ULFA
people for handing them over to India;
(b) if so, the details thereof and when it
was handed over; and
(c) the action on the said list upto
October, 2006?
Relaxation in SEZ rules
*220. PROF. P.J. KURIEN : Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether some States have been
allowed relaxation in some requirements for
setting up Special Economic Zones;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the reline
adopted; and
(c) the reasons for which Kerala has not
been allowed such relaxation?

Export-import between India and
China
†1484. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether import-export between
India and China has increased after opening
of  Nathula route, for trade between the
two countries;
(b) whether Government propose to
extend the current maximum limit of trade,
to increase trade between the two countries;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Welfare of Virginia tobacco
growers in A.P.
1485. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
census of the economic state and welfare
of Virginia tobacco farmers of Andhra
Pradesh;
(b) if so, whether the Tobacco Board
has been involved in this exercise;
(c) how many farmers have sought
permission to grow more tobacco;
(d) whether Government granted this
permission; and
(e) the steps proposed to improve income
of tobacco farmers of Andhra Pradesh?
Export of unmanufactured
tobacco
1486. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what is the total quantity and value
of export of unmanufactured tobacco during
the last three years, year-wise;
(b) the break-up of such exports, giving
figures of different types of tobacco
separately during the above period;
(c) whether Government would assist
such exports; and
(d) if so, the details of steps proposed
in this regard?

336
Waiver of interest on loans of coffee
growers
1487. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the coffee growers have
approached the Centre for waiver of interest
component on the plantation loan obtained
by them; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and Centre's
reaction thereto?
Reduction in export of iron-ore
†1488. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
any proposal for reducing the export of
iron-ore in a phased manner;
(b) the quantity of iron-ore exported
during last financial year;
(c) the amount of revenue earned by
Government from this export during this
period; and
(d) whether Government intend to levy
any cess on the export of iron-ore per ton?
Dry ports in India
1489. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the number of dry ports in India,
State-wise;
(b) whether there is a dearth of dry
ports in India; and
(c) if so, the action being taken by
Government to establish more dry ports in
the country, in order to reduce congestion,
by allowing container to transit smoothly
at seaports without further delay?
SEZ at Gwalior
†1490. SHRI LAXMINARAYAN
SHARMA: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that setting up of
a Special Economic Zone in Gwalior has
been agreed to in principle; and
(b) if so, by when the work relating to
its setting up is likely to be commenced?
Acquisition of land for SEZs
1491. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether land acquisition for Special
Economic Zones (SEZs) has been initiated/
is on the anvil, by the competent Authority;
(b) if so, the details, including the number
of SEZs in final nod and approved in
principle, land to be taken or taken over for
SEZs, category-wise, State-wise as on date;
(c) the details of agricultural land and
the land identified for mineral resources
marketed or taken for SEZs, category-wise,
State-wise, as on date; and
(d) the details of corporate houses
associated with SEZs and the nature of land
transfer in SEZs as on date, State-wise and
category-wise?
RBI suggestions regarding SEZs
1492. SHRI P.R. RAJAN: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what is Government’s policy on setting
up of SEZs in various parts of the country;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

337
(b) whether Government would adhere
to the suggestions proposed by the Reserve
Bank of India that SEZs would aggravate
uneven development in the country; and
(c) whether the Finance Ministry has
raised any objections about the existing
exporters moving to SEZs, to save taxes?
Defining waste land for SEZs
1493. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the term waste land in
acquiring the land for Special Economic
Zones has been defined in clear terms, so
that it may be uniformly applied across
the country;
(b) if so, the details in this regard; and
(c) whether it is a fact that a fertile land
at times can become waste land, in view of
unclear title or dispute, if so, what checks
Government propose to take in this regard?
Impact on food production due to
conversion of fertile land into SEZs
1494. SHRI SITARAM YECHURY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of area which is facing
threat of acquisition from the proposed
SEZs;
(b) the percentage of arable land, in
comparison to the total agricultural land in
that particular State, which is facing such
threat;
(c) whether any study has been
undertaken by Government to find out the
impact of converting fertile land into SEZs
on the production of foodgrains;
(d) if not, whether there are any plans
to do so; and
(e) if not, how Government are going
ahead to convert the arable land into non-
arable land?
Concessions for special Economic
Zones
1495. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of concessions proposed
to be granted for the SEZs by the Centre
and the States and the likely revenue
implications of these concessions for the
Centre and the States, Zone-wise;
(b) the price at which the land is being
allotted to the promoters and the price at
which the land is proposed to be sold by
the promoters, Zone-wise; and
(c) the likely number of people to be
displaced and the compensation to be paid
to each person displaced, Zone-wise?
Promoters for SEZs
1496. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the names of Special Economic
Zones and the area of land over which each
Zone is to be set up;
(b) the promoter selected for each
Special Economic Zone; and
(c) the investment by the promoter and
the likely total investment in each of these
Zones, Zone-wise?
Hurdles faced by exporters
1497. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is purposed to set up an
inter-Ministerial committee to clear hurdles
faced by exporters;

338
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Limit on SEZs in each State
1498. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether a limit has been fixed for
setting up of Special Economic Zones in
every State;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether the norms would be revised;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Implementation of SAFTA
1499. SHRI RAHUL BAJAJ: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state the current
status of implementation of South Asian
Free Trade Agreement (SAFTA) by each
member country?
Displacement of people due to SEZs
1500. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Special
Economic Zones, which are being
developed/proposed to be developed in
various States, are likely to displace lakhs
of people and also result in land scams; and
(b) if so, the steps being taken by
Government to prevent land scams, huge
revenue losses and to rehabilitate the people
being displaced by the Special Economic
Zones?
R.B.I. directive to nationalised banks
for credit to SEZs
1501. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken any
steps in preventing the realtors entering as
SEZs promoters, and to save the agricultural
lands;
(b) if so, what are the guidelines and the
economic concessions; and
(c) whether it is also a fact that RBI has
directed the nationalized banks to offer
credit to SEZs on the same terms and
conditions, as offered to real estate developers?
Amount spent by I.T.P.O. on trade fair
†1502. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the total amount spent on
maintenance etc. on every trade fair by the
Indian Trade Promotion Organisation in
Delhi, till date;
(b) the details of income earned by the
Indian Trade Promotion Organisation from
every trade fair;
(c) the year-wise amount spent on
pavilions of States/other countries in these
trade fairs by the Indian Trade Promotion
Organisation during last three years; and
(d) the details of income earned from
pavilions, State-wise/country-wise?
Development of industry in J & K
1503. SHRI T.S. BAJWA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the action pending on
the proposals and projects announced by
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

339
Government for the development of
industry in Jammu and Kashmir;
(b) whether there is any other package
under Government's consideration to boost
industry in the State; and
(c) if so, by when that is likely to be
announced?
New guidelines for SEZs
†1504. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided to formulate and implement
the new guidelines, for bringing expediency
in development of Special Economic Zones
(SEZs) in the country;
(b) whether Government have also
decided to have dialogue and consultation
with all the State Governments, prior to
implementation of the said guidelines;
(c) whether it is a fact that 150
proposals for setting up of Special
Economic Zones have been disposed of so
far, and around 300 proposals are under
consideration; and
(d) if so, the State-wise details thereof?
WTO compliant tax concessions to SEZs
1505. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have ensured
that the tax concessions and duty reliefs
given to SEZs are WTO compliant; if so,
the details thereof; and
(b) what steps are being taken to ensure
that the SEZs achieve their export
objectives, without violating the norms set
by WTO?
Revival of sick industries
1506. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made any
assessment of the industrial sickness
prevalent in the existing industrial estates
in the country;
(b) if so, what steps are being taken to
revive such industrial estates;
(c) whether Government propose to
give these estates similar tax concessions
and infrastructure facilities as SEZs;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
FDI in higher education
1507. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether sensing the keenness of
many foreign universities in setting up
shops in India for imparting higher
education, Government are planning to open
up the higher education sector to 100
per cent FDI;
(b) whether Government would
attempt to arrive at a consensus by debating
the issue with all the stake holders, like
universities and Ministry of HRD, and the
academicia; and
(c) whether Government propose to
grant the foreign educational institutions
the freedom to determine salaries of the
faculty and staff and fixing fees, outside
the purview of the UGC?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

340
Engagement of foreign workers in
SEZs
1508. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether many of the newly
upcoming SEZ projects face teething
problems in engaging foreign workers;
(b) whether many visa applications
from Sri Lankan, Taiwanese and Chinese
workers/technicians are held up for
clearance in the Ministries of Home Affairs
and External Affairs; and
(c) whether such delays in the issue of
visa for workers and technicians from
abroad will have adverse impact on foreign
companies, with huge investment plans in
the SEZs?
Import of vanaspati from Sri Lanka
1509. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are importing vanaspati from Sri Lanka; and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and the
details of quantity imported during the last
three years, year-wise?
Problems of Indian business in
acquiring companies abroad
1510. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken a
view of the impediments faced by Indian
business due to non-economic considera-
tions in acquiring companies abroad,
particularly in Europe;
(b) if so, the details of Government's
assessment and if not, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government have raised the
issue at appropriate fora;
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor;
(e) whether our Missions in the
respective countries are mandated to take
up such issues with the local Government;
and
(f) if so, the details of the action taken
by our missions and if not, the reasons
therefor?
Import-Export target
1511. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have set a
target for foreign trade for the year at more
than US $ 450 billion;
(b) if so, whether this figure would
include export and import of services;
(c) what is the expected quantum of
traditional exports of this figure; and
(d) the details of break-up of traditional
exports like Tea, Coffee, Jute etc.?
SEZs in Punjab
1512. SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
